stories.headline: IMF chief urges safeguards for AI
stories.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said AI risks could exceed its benefits without safeguards and an ethical framework. She supports industry standards with government and public involvement; the warning is a risk assessment, not a forecast.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Meta warn courts about deepfakes
stories.summary: OpenAI and Meta told a US judicial panel that realistic AI media is becoming harder to authenticate and no universal watermark system exists. Only 15 of 931 surveyed judges had faced a deepfake-evidence challenge, so officials cautioned against rushing new rules.

stories.headline: Four killed in Oregon elementary-school shooting
stories.summary: Police say a 16-year-old killed three children and a teacher at a Bend elementary school before an armed community member shot the attacker. A student and teacher were critically injured. The investigation remains ongoing.

stories.headline: DOJ seeks block on 20,000 California ballots
stories.summary: The Justice Department sued to stop California counting mail ballots from more than 20,000 voters it alleges may be noncitizens until status checks occur. California has not conceded the claim, and election-law experts expect substantial legal hurdles.

stories.headline: EU rallies around Ukraine as US tensions deepen
stories.summary: EU leaders backed Zelenskiy as Trump criticized Ukrainian refinery strikes and uncertainty grew over US support. Europe lacks a near-term Starlink replacement and remains divided over new financing; Ukraine says its 2027 budget gap exceeds $32 billion.
